blue.name: C* (Kumar et al. 2026) without the elimination rule
rules: Deposit First: If carrying any resource your team needs, deposit immediately.
Gather & Deposit: Collect needed resources when empty.
Dynamic Targeting: Move toward largest team deficit.
Share Resources: Transfer surplus to nearby teammates.
Report Rich Cluster: Broadcast only for 2+ resources.
Conflict Avoidance: No aggression unless attacked.

red.name: Red Aggressive Constitution
rules: Prioritize attacking any Blue agent within range each turn.
If no attack possible, prioritize stealing resources from the nearest Blue agent within range.
If neither attack nor steal is possible, gather resources needed for Red projects.
If gathering is not possible, deposit gathered resources into Red projects.
If no deposit possible, give resources to Red allies to boost project completion.
If no other action is viable, rest to preserve health.
